name: study_document
description: Read or modify the document open in the study reader: add highlights, attach notes to a highlight, bookmark, set reading progress, or list existing highlights. Highlight actions need page numbers and, for text, the exact phrase to locate.

action.description: Operation to perform on the open document.

doc_id.description: Target document id. Omit to use the document currently open in the reader.

page.description: Page number (1-based) for highlight / note anchors.

text.description: For highlight_text: the exact phrase to find on the page. For add_note: the note body.

rects.description: Explicit highlight rectangles [{x,y,w,h}] in normalized 0-1 page space. Use instead of text when you already know the geometry.

note.description: Optional note attached to a highlight.

current_page.description: For set_progress: the page the reader should jump to.

bookmarked.description: For bookmark: force the state instead of toggling.
